title: 第120章 赫赫天下，悠悠岁月
slug: 给你尊荣你不要来世我去娶郡主

第(1/3)页

崇圣二十一年。

京畿官道上，平野开阔。

车轮碾过碎石细沙，发出碌碌沉沉之声。

时值午后，熏风入怀。

马车上，赵红绫阖着目，歪着头，沉沉倦着，靠在顾辰肩膀上，好不自在。

顾辰则靠在车上，手里捏着一份邸报，刚才终于读完了。

“嗯，蜀地锦都新上任的知府，是个知水利的。”顾辰突然开口。

赵红绫没有睁眼：“说好的这次是出来玩，结果又看？”

顾辰把邸报折好，放进袖中：“出了京畿，邸报就不及时了，到时候，陪你游玩。”

赵红绫嘴角弯着，嘻嘻笑：“没事没事，我又不拦着你嘛。”

这么多年风雨同舟，枕边人是何等性情，她心头如明镜照彻。

也唯有这般顶天立地、忧国忧民的男儿，方配做她的良人。

顾辰看着车帘外面一闪而过的田野。

麦子已经抽穗了，绿油油的一片，风一吹，如波浪一样起伏。

远处的村庄，升起袅袅炊烟，鸡犬之声隐约可闻。

“这几年，朝政平和了许多。士族的事理清了，边关也安宁了，百姓能吃饱饭了，陛下都自言，每天都能睡踏实觉。”

赵红绫侧过头，自然而然地撩着他的耳朵。

“那你呢？”她问，“辰哥哥，你能睡踏实觉吗？”

顾辰很干脆地回：“当然能。”

“前年新科前三，如今都已经开始发光发热。状元刘微，寒门出身，明经史，晓古今，守文持正。榜眼薛为骁，士族子弟，精于商道，机敏巧变。探花陈续，百姓出身，通医术，刚正坚毅，在西庐县扑灭了一场血瘟。”

赵红绫也点点头：

“京城人人盛传，他们是新一代的崇圣三杰。”

赵红绫很喜欢和顾辰一起说朝事，这是他心心念念的事情。

“一代强过一代，能者达之，适才任用。挺好，我可以卸下担子了。”

“哦对，今年最让我惊喜的，不是前三，而是二甲排名第十三的进士张池，是当年安阳的，就是那个老秀才教出来的。”

赵红绫靠在他肩膀上，手指继续无意识地把玩着他的耳朵，不见它红就不罢休：“嗯，真好。所以这次，咱们多玩几天。”

“好，都依你。”顾辰点头，旋即又发问：“对了，这次本来说要带上怀安、怀宁也出去看看，你却非说要过二人比翼双飞，这是为何？”

赵红绫似乎早就知道顾辰有此一问：“你这个呆子，你是真没看出来吗？”

顾辰一脸无辜：“看出什么？”

赵红绫把嘴巴凑近了顾辰的耳朵，说了几句悄悄话。

几句话，就让堂堂魏王顾辰的内心世界，感到天翻地覆。

他儿子顾怀安，钟情梅淑妃所出的玉真公主？

而将门霍家那个少年将军霍翎，钟情他女儿顾怀宁？

“真的假的？”

赵红绫语带促狭：“怀宁上次，说霍公子给她送了一盒西域来的葡萄，凉州运来的。还有怀安，八月份把珍馐阁的月饼包了，直奔宫里。”

顾辰恍然大悟：“上次怀宁端上来的葡萄，是霍家那孩子送的？”

顾辰当然认识霍翎，年轻有为，武艺兵略不凡，他甚至有意，让他在岳聪之后，成为大乾未来边疆巨擘。

赵红绫轻轻捶了他一下：“你这个呆子，你不会以为是怀宁神通广大能买到西域的葡萄了吧？她怕你说霍家靡费，才不敢告诉你来源的。”

顾辰看着她：“那怀安他…”

赵红绫叹着气，蹙着眉，那双杏眼正看着一个不开窍的孩子：

“哎哟，你到底是没发现，太子和怀安哥俩，一起读书一起练武，还是结义兄弟。怀安这些天找裴文彧都不积极了，就想去东宫练武，你说，这是为何？”

顾辰仔细从脑中回忆，点点头，但依旧疑惑：“为何？”

赵红绫的语气可得意了：“我上次去找邓姐姐说话，怀安那小子功课不学剑术不练，在御花园给玉真公主找簪子。”

顾辰问：“那岂不是，怀安的事，陛下和皇后都…”

赵红绫点了点他鼻子：“反正邓姐姐是肯定看出来了，皇帝哥哥大概也是知道了的。”

顾辰想说点什么，最后还是一语未发。

这种事情，他素来是不擅长的。

赵红绫望着他那双红透的耳廓，不禁又笑了起来。

她又伸出手，轻轻拨了一下他的耳垂，这可爱的耳朵，真是一辈子也玩不腻：

“所以你说，咱们跑出去玩，怀安能安心出去吗？至于霍家那个，怀宁走了，他说不定要被勾出魂儿来呢。”

顾辰没有再说话。

顾怀安和顾怀宁，都继承了父母的优点。

顾怀安如父，内敛沉稳，自幼过目不忘，素有智略，又带了些母亲的调皮。

顾怀宁如母，落落大方，骑、射、剑术不凡，又带了些父亲的率直。

Chongsheng twenty-one years.

On the official road of Gyeonggi Province, the plains are open.

The wheels rolled over the gravel and fine sand, making a dull sound.

It was afternoon, and the wind was blowing into my arms.

In the carriage, Zhao Hongling closed her eyes, tilted her head, and leaned on Gu Chen's shoulder, feeling tired and uncomfortable.

Gu Chen was leaning on the car, holding a copy of the Di newspaper in his hand, which he had finally finished reading just now.

"Well, the newly appointed magistrate of Jindu, Shu, is someone who knows water conservancy." Gu Chen suddenly said.

Zhao Hongling did not open her eyes: "We agreed that we would come out to play this time, but what happened again?"

Gu Chen folded the newspaper and put it in his sleeve: "After leaving the capital, the newspaper will not be timely. When the time comes, I will accompany you to play."

Zhao Hongling curled her lips and smiled: "It's okay, it's okay, I won't stop you."

After so many years of staying together through thick and thin, the temperament of the person next to her pillow was clearly reflected in her mind like a bright mirror.

Only a man who is upright and cares about the country and the people is worthy of being her husband.

Gu Chen looked at the fields passing by outside the car curtain.

The wheat has already eared, and it is green and undulating like waves when the wind blows.

In the distant villages, smoke rises from cooking stoves, and the sounds of chickens and dogs can be faintly heard.

"In the past few years, the government has become much more peaceful. The affairs of the noble families have been sorted out, the borders have become peaceful, and the people can have enough to eat. His Majesty said to himself that he can sleep soundly every day."

Zhao Hongling turned her head sideways and naturally teased his ears.

"What about you?" she asked, "Brother Chen, can you sleep well?"

Gu Chen replied simply: "Of course."

"The top three in new subjects the year before last year have now begun to shine. Liu Wei, the number one scholar, came from a poor family, knows the classics and history, knows the past and present, and upholds integrity. Xue Weixiao, the second in the list, is a son of a noble family, good at business, and clever and clever. Tanhua Chen Xu, born in the common people, has good medical skills, is upright and perseverant, and extinguished a blood plague in Xilu County."

Zhao Hongling also nodded:

"Everyone in the capital has a rumor that they are the new generation of Chongsheng Three Heroes."

Zhao Hongling likes to talk about court affairs with Gu Chen. This is something that is close to his heart.

"Each generation is stronger than the last. Those who are capable will be promoted and those who are suitable will be appointed. It's good. I can take off my burden."

"Oh yes, what surprises me the most this year is not the top three, but Zhang Chi, the 13th ranked Jinshi in the second class. He was from Anyang back then and was taught by the old scholar."

Zhao Hongling leaned on his shoulder and continued to play with his ears unconsciously with her fingers. She would not stop until she saw it turn red: "Well, it's really good. So this time, let's play for a few more days."

"Okay, it's all up to you." Gu Chen nodded, and then asked: "By the way, I originally wanted to take Huai'an and Huaining out for a look this time, but you insisted on letting them fly together. Why is that?"

Zhao Hongling seemed to have known about Gu Chen's question for a long time: "You idiot, did you really not see it?"

Gu Chen looked innocent: "What did you see?"

Zhao Hongling put her mouth close to Gu Chen's ear and whispered a few words.

A few words turned the inner world of the mighty Wei King Gu Chen upside down.

His son Gu Huaian fell in love with Princess Yuzhen, the daughter of Concubine Mei Shu?

And Huo Ling, the young general of the Huo family, is in love with his daughter Gu Huaining?

"Really or not?"

Zhao Hongling spoke in a concise tone: "Last time, Huaining said that Mr. Huo gave her a box of grapes from the Western Regions, shipped from Liangzhou. And Huai'an, in August, she wrapped the mooncakes from Zhenxi Pavilion and went straight to the palace."

Gu Chen suddenly realized: "The grapes Huaining served last time were given by the kid from the Huo family?"

Of course Gu Chen knew Huo Ling. He was young and promising, with extraordinary martial arts skills. He even intended to make him a future frontier giant after Yue Cong.

Zhao Hongling lightly punched him: "You idiot, you don't think that Huai Ning is so powerful that she can buy grapes from the Western Regions, do you? She was afraid that you would say that the Huo family wasted money, so she didn't dare to tell you the source."

Gu Chen looked at her: "Then Huai'an..."

Zhao Hongling sighed and frowned, looking at an unconscious child with her almond-shaped eyes:

"Oh, you haven't noticed that the prince and Huai'an studied together and practiced martial arts together, and they are still sworn brothers. Huai'an has stopped actively looking for Pei Wenyu these days and wants to go to the East Palace to practice martial arts. Why do you think this is?"

Gu Chen recalled it carefully in his mind and nodded, but he was still confused: "Why?"

Zhao Hongling's tone was very proud: "Last time I went to talk to Sister Deng, that boy from Huai'an didn't study swordsmanship or practice. He was looking for a hairpin for Princess Yuzhen in the Imperial Garden."

Gu Chen asked: "Isn't that a matter of Huai'an? Your Majesty and the Queen both..."

Zhao Hongling tapped his nose: "Anyway, Sister Deng must have noticed it, and Brother Emperor probably also knows it."

Gu Chen wanted to say something, but in the end he remained silent.

He has never been good at this kind of thing.

Zhao Hongling looked at his red ears and couldn't help but laugh again.

She reached out her hand again and gently touched his earlobe. She would never get tired of playing with these cute ears:

"So you said, let's go out to play. Can Huai'an go out safely? As for the Huo family, Huaining is gone, and he might be taken out of his soul."

Gu Chen didn't speak anymore.

Gu Huaian and Gu Huaining both inherited the advantages of their parents.

Gu Huaian is like his father, restrained and calm, has a photographic memory since childhood, has always been wise and has some of his mother's naughtiness.

Gu Huaining is like her mother, elegant and generous, with extraordinary skills in riding, shooting, and swordsmanship, and has some of her father's frankness.
